Changed #1551

Pyrois

★★★★★
View details

Mindscape Cinema

Morning Star at Dawn
Morning Star at Dawn
When any squad member triggers [Contamination], Pyrois gains 1 stack of [Radiant Edge], stacking up to 3 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s. When the heavy attack of [Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm] hits an enemy, Pyrois gains 3 stacks of [Radiant Edge]. This effect can trigger once every 20s. When Pyrois uses the 4th hit of [Basic Attack: Celestial Light] or the downward slash of [Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm] while she has [Radiant Edge], she consumes 1 stack of [Radiant Edge] to enhance the skill. The enhanced skill deals additional DMG equal to 510% of her ATK. If it hits an enemy under [Contamination], she also gains 250 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 6s. When [Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm] hits an enemy suffering from a Wind Attribute Anomaly, it forcibly triggers [Contamination] once. Its heavy attack deals additional DMG equal to 1,000% of ATK when it hits an enemy under [Contamination]. When [Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm] is activated, all enemies that are both in Daze and suffering from a Wind Attribute Anomaly have their Stun duration extended by 3s. Each enemy can only receive Pyrois's Stun duration extension once per Daze, and this effect does not stack with similar effects.Mindscape Effect Hidden

Special Attack: Robin ExitRobin_Skill_Special_Title
Robin_Skill_Special_Title
Press to activate:
Leaps high into the air and unleashes an Energy Blast around her, dealing massive Ether DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After activation, triggers a Quick Assist. After switching out, Robin enters the [Off-Field Guard] state for 60s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Also grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to 2% of Robin's initial Max HP, lasting 15s.
While Robin is in the [Off-Field Guard] state, she can only be switched in via [Chain Attack], [Entry Skill], or [Counter Assist]. Switching her in ends the [Off-Field Guard] state.
While [Off-Field Guard] is active, all squad members gain bonus DEF: when Robin's initial Max HP exceeds 16,000, every 1,000 additional HP grants 92.0 DEF, up to a maximum of 920.0 DEF. This effect lasts for another 15s after Robin's [Off-Field Guard] state ends.Robin_Skill_Special_Desc
Special Attack: AftershockRobin_Skill_CoAttack_Title
Robin_Skill_CoAttack_Title
While Robin is in the [Off-Field Guard] state, this skill triggers automatically when another active character in the squad lands any attack on an enemy:
Swings her staff to attack forward, dealing Ether DMG;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill;
Upon activation, gains 20 [Entry Points] and grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to 3% of Robin's initial Max HP, lasting 15s;
[Special Attack: Aftershock] counts as an Aftershock and can be triggered at most once every 8s.Robin_Skill_CoAttack_Desc
EX Special Attack: Enhanced AftershockRobin_Skill_EnhanceCoAttack_Title
Robin_Skill_EnhanceCoAttack_Title
When activating [Special Attack: Aftershock], if Energy is at least 40, it is upgraded to [EX Special Attack: Enhanced Aftershock]:
Continuously consumes a total of 40 Energy to fire a powerful laser forward, dealing massive Ether DMG;
Robin's heavy attacks deal additional DMG equal to 66.2% of her Max HP;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill;
Upon activation, gains 20 [Entry Points] and grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to 6% of her initial Max HP, lasting 15s;
[EX Special Attack: Enhanced Aftershock] counts as an Aftershock.Robin_Skill_EnhanceCoAttack_Desc

Special Attack: Robin ExitRobin_Skill_Special_Title
Robin_Skill_Special_Title
Press to activate:
Leaps high into the air and unleashes an Energy Blast around her, dealing massive Ether DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After activation, triggers a Quick Assist. After switching out, Robin enters the [Off-Field Guard] state for 60s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Also grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to 2% of Robin's initial Max HP, lasting 15s.
While Robin is in the [Off-Field Guard] state, she can only be switched in via [Chain Attack], [Entry Skill], or [Counter Assist]. Switching her in ends the [Off-Field Guard] state.
While [Off-Field Guard] is active, all squad members gain bonus DEF: when Robin's initial Max HP exceeds 16,000, every 1,000 additional HP grants 92.0 DEF, up to a maximum of 920.0 DEF. This effect lasts for another 15s after Robin's [Off-Field Guard] state ends.Robin_Skill_Special_Desc
Special Attack: AftershockRobin_Skill_CoAttack_Title
Robin_Skill_CoAttack_Title
While Robin is in the [Off-Field Guard] state, this skill triggers automatically when another active character in the squad lands any attack on an enemy:
Swings her staff to attack forward, dealing Ether DMG;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill;
Upon activation, gains 20 [Entry Points] and grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to 3% of Robin's initial Max HP, lasting 15s;
[Special Attack: Aftershock] counts as an Aftershock and can be triggered at most once every 8s.Robin_Skill_CoAttack_Desc
EX Special Attack: Enhanced AftershockRobin_Skill_EnhanceCoAttack_Title
Robin_Skill_EnhanceCoAttack_Title
When activating [Special Attack: Aftershock], if Energy is at least 40, it is upgraded to [EX Special Attack: Enhanced Aftershock]:
Continuously consumes a total of 40 Energy to fire a powerful laser forward, dealing massive Ether DMG;
Robin's heavy attacks deal additional DMG equal to 66.2% of her Max HP;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill;
Upon activation, gains 20 [Entry Points] and grants all squad members a [Robin Shield] equal to 6% of her initial Max HP, lasting 15s;
[EX Special Attack: Enhanced Aftershock] counts as an Aftershock.Robin_Skill_EnhanceCoAttack_Desc

Core passives

Core Passive:Robin_UniqueSkill_Title
Robin_UniqueSkill_Title
When Robin uses certain skills, she grants all squad members a shield [Robin Shield] based on a varying percentage of Robin's initial Max HP, lasting 15s. When a character gains [Robin Shield] again, the shield value stacks and the duration of [Robin Shield] is extended, up to a maximum of 60s. The shield value cannot exceed 8% of Robin's initial Max HP;
Each time a squad member gains [Robin Shield], their DMG increases by 12.5% for 15s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration;
Using [Special Attack: Step Up] triggers a Quick Assist. After switching out, Robin enters the [Off-Field Guard] state for 60s. While in the [Off-Field Guard] state, Robin's Aftershocks grant [Entry Points], up to a maximum of 120;
When [Entry Points] are at 100 or above, Robin can be actively switched in via [Entry Skill]. Switching in automatically consumes 100 [Entry Points] to activate [Entry Skill] and ends the [Off-Field Guard] state;
When activating [Entry Skill], Robin gains 1 [Buff Enhance Point], up to a maximum of 1;
When entering the [Off-Field Guard] state, if Robin has a [Buff Enhance Point], 1 [Buff Enhance Point] is consumed to further increase the DEF boost provided by the [Off-Field Guard] state and its cap by 25%;
Each time a squad member triggers Maim, Robin restores 15 Energy.Robin_UniqueSkill_01_Desc
Core Passive:Robin_UniqueSkill_Title
Robin_UniqueSkill_Title

Each time a squad member triggers Maim, Robin restores 15 Energy.Robin_UniqueSkill_02_Desc

When [Entry Points] are at 100 or above, Robin can be actively switched in via [Entry Skill]. On switching in, she automatically consumes 100 [Entry Points] to use [Entry Skill] and exits the [Off-Field Guard] state.
When using [Entry Skill], Robin gains 1 [Buff Enhance Point], up to a maximum of 1.
When entering the [Off-Field Guard] state, if Robin has a [Buff Enhance Point], she consumes 1 [Buff Enhance Point] to further increase the DEF boost granted by [Off-Field Guard] and its cap by 25%.
Each time a squad member triggers Maim, Robin restores 15 Energy.Robin_UniqueSkill_02_Desc

Basic Attack: ThornbreakerLindverne_Skill_Normal_Title
Lindverne_Skill_Normal_Title
Press to activate:
Lindverne performs up to 4 consecutive attacks forward, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold during the 4th attack to perform an extended slash against enemies.
When the heavy attack of the 4th attack hits an enemy with [Gash], consume all [Gash] stacks on the target, up to 3 stacks. For each [Gash] stack consumed, trigger [Maim] on the target once, dealing additional AoE Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
During the 3rd and 4th attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.Lindverne_Skill_Normal_Desc
Basic Attack: BannerbearerEldreda_Skill_Normal_Title
Eldreda_Skill_Normal_Title
Press to activate:
Eldreda performs up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Genesis Flare DMG;
When the heavy attack of the fourth hit lands on an enemy with [Gash], it consumes all [Gash] stacks on the target, up to 3 stacks. For each stack of [Gash] consumed, triggers [Maim] on the target once, dealing additional AoE Genesis Flare DMG;
During the third and fourth hits, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.Eldreda_Skill_Normal_Desc

Core passives

Core Passive:Sunbringer_UniqueSkill_Title
Sunbringer_UniqueSkill_Title
All DMG dealt by Sunbringer's skills is Sharp DMG, which uses DEF for the skill DMG Multiplier. Some Sharp DMG accumulates Gash value. When the Gash value is full, the enemy enters [Gash]. [Gash] can stack up to 3 times. When certain heavy attacks from Sunbringer's skills hit an enemy in the [Gash] state, 1 stack of [Gash] is consumed to deal AoE DMG once;
When a critical hit is triggered, Sharp DMG does not benefit from CRIT DMG Bonus and uses Laceration DMG Bonus instead. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a critical hit has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is made based on the excess CRIT Rate. If Laceration is triggered, Laceration DMG Bonus is applied one additional time. For every 1% initial CRIT DMG Sunbringer has, Sunbringer's initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%;
When Sunbringer enters the battlefield, Sunbringer immediately restores 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s;
When Sunbringer enters combat, Sunbringer gains the [Midnight Sun] effect, increasing CRIT Rate by 40% and ignoring 20% of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. [Midnight Sun] lasts 15s, and its duration stops decreasing while Eldreda and Lindverne are off field. Sunbringer regains the [Midnight Sun] effect upon activating any [EX Special Attack] or [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];
After Dracaene performs a [Defensive Assist], the [Assist Follow-Up] performed by Eldreda and Lindverne gains 15% increased Gash Buildup Rate and deals 20% increased DMG;
When any Agent in the squad triggers [Maim], Sunbringer gains 40 [Willpower] for each stack of [Gash] removed, up to a maximum of 160 [Willpower]. When Sunbringer has at least 120 [Willpower], 120 [Willpower] can be consumed to activate [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];
When a teammate triggers [Maim], if Sunbringer has enough [Willpower], a [Quick Assist] is triggered. When Sunbringer switches on field via [Quick Assist], 120 [Willpower] is consumed to directly activate [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge]. This effect can trigger once every 3s;
When Sunbringer's [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge], [EX Special Attack: Night Blaze - End of the Long Dark], [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day], [Ultimate: "Onward, Together"], or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy and deals DMG, the target accumulates [Ember Scar] equal to 75% of the actual DMG dealt by the skill. When the Finishing Move of Eldreda's [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day] or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy, all [Ember Scar] is removed, directly deducting an equal amount of HP.
When an attack hits a normal enemy, if that enemy's [Ember Scar] is greater than or equal to its current HP, all of its [Ember Scar] is removed and the enemy is instantly defeated.Sunbringer_UniqueSkill_01_Desc

Sunbringer recovers 60 Sharpness upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s;
When Sunbringer enters combat, Sunbringer gains [Midnight Sun], increasing CRIT Rate by 40% and ignoring 20% of the target's DEF when dealing DMG. [Midnight Sun] lasts 15s. While Eldreda and Lindverne are off field, its duration no longer decreases. Sunbringer regains [Midnight Sun] upon using any [EX Special Attack] or [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];
After Dracaene uses [Defensive Assist], the [Assist Follow-Up] used by Eldreda and Lindverne gains 15% increased Gash Buildup Rate and deals 20% more DMG;
When any Agent in the squad triggers [Maim], Sunbringer gains 40 [Willpower] for each stack of [Gash] removed, up to a maximum of 160 [Willpower]. With at least 120 [Willpower], 120 [Willpower] can be consumed to activate [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];
When a teammate triggers [Maim], if Sunbringer has enough [Willpower], [Quick Assist] is triggered. When Sunbringer switches on field via [Quick Assist], 120 [Willpower] is consumed to instantly activate [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge]. This effect can trigger once every 3s;
When Sunbringer's [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge], [EX Special Attack: Night Blaze - End of the Long Dark], [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day], [Ultimate: "Onward, Together"], or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy and deals DMG, the target accumulates [Ember Scar] equal to 75% of the actual DMG dealt by the skill. When the Finishing Move of Eldreda's [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day] or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy, all [Ember Scar] is removed, directly deducting an equal amount of HP.
When an attack hits a normal enemy, if that enemy's [Ember Scar] is equal to or greater than its current HP, all of its [Ember Scar] is removed and the enemy is instantly defeated.Sunbringer_UniqueSkill_06_Desc

When she enters combat, Sunbringer gains [Midnight Sun], increasing CRIT Rate by 40% and allowing her DMG to ignore 20% of the target's DEF. [Midnight Sun] lasts 15s. While Eldreda and Lindverne are off field, its duration no longer decreases. Sunbringer regains [Midnight Sun] whenever she uses any [EX Special Attack] or [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];
After Dracaene performs a [Defensive Assist], the [Assist Follow-Up] performed by Eldreda and Lindverne gains 15% increased Gash Buildup Rate and deals 20% more DMG;
Whenever any Agent in the squad triggers [Maim], Sunbringer gains 40 [Willpower] for each stack of [Gash] removed, up to a maximum of 160 [Willpower]. When she has at least 120 [Willpower], she can consume 120 [Willpower] to perform [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge];
When a teammate triggers [Maim], if Sunbringer has enough [Willpower], [Quick Assist] is triggered. When Sunbringer switches on field via [Quick Assist], she consumes 120 [Willpower] to immediately perform [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge]. This effect can trigger once every 3s;
When Sunbringer's [Basic Attack: Bannerbearer - Converging Edge], [EX Special Attack: Night Blaze - End of the Long Dark], [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day], [Ultimate: "Onward, Together"], or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy and deals DMG, the target accumulates [Ember Scar] equal to 75% of the actual DMG dealt by the skill. When the Finishing Move of Eldreda's [EX Special Attack: Kindled Lamp - Torch of Eternal Day] or [Ultimate: "By This Wish, All Things Remade"] hits an enemy, all [Ember Scar] is cleared, directly deducting an equal amount of HP.
When an attack hits normal enemies, if the enemy's [Ember Scar] is greater than or equal to its current HP, all of its [Ember Scar] is immediately cleared and the enemy is defeated.Sunbringer_UniqueSkill_02_Desc

Even soaring to the heights, one can never truly reach the sky.
Yet someone must always stand a little higher—for even glimpsing just an inch more Celestial Light than the rest of the world might be enough to seek out a glimmer of hope in this long, endless night.
